##### Project general facts

Perla 2 is a residential development by Reportage Properties offering a refined residential experience in the vibrant Yas Bay on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. The building features two basement levels, a ground floor, eleven residential floors, and a rooftop, with a selection of thoughtfully designed apartments showcasing signature Italian finishes. The architecture blends modern simplicity with functional layouts, creating comfortable living spaces suited for both end-users and investors. The collection includes three-, four- and five-bedroom duplex apartments together with four-bedroom simplex apartments, positioned to offer sea views across all 115 homes.

The development is designed to support a well-balanced lifestyle, with a wide range of amenities including two large swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, landscaped areas, barbecue zones, children’s playgrounds, and dedicated parking. Residents also benefit from concierge services, ensuring convenience and day-to-day support. The community is complemented by the dynamic surroundings of Yas Island, known for its entertainment destinations, retail hubs, and well-developed infrastructure.

Units feature kitchen cabinets and countertops, fully tiled bathrooms, en-suites and guest toilets, and a shower with handle and walk-in bathtub shower in each bathroom, with built-in wardrobes in the bedrooms. Homes are centrally air conditioned and finished with vanity units and mirrors, double-glazed windows, and a satellite master antenna with fibre-optic connection for high-speed internet access, with balconies or terraces provided as per each unit's plan. The residences are delivered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits


Nestled in Yas South, a perfect opportunity for residence and investment, this exceptional location is Abu Dhabi's premier waterfront destination. Yas Bay is a mixed-use development comprising three main distinct areas: the Waterfront, a vibrant leisure and entertainment district with Hilton Hotel, cafes, restaurants, retail outlets, a boutique cinema, a beach club, and the award-winning Etihad Arena; Residences at Yas Bay, a unique contemporary residential community offering the complete Yas Island lifestyle; and the Media Zone, featuring the new campus for twofour54.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to world-class attractions. Ferrari World, Yas Waterworld, Warner Bros. World, Yas Mall, Etihad Arena, and Yas Beach are all minutes away. Louvre Museum, Al Reem Island, Saadiyat Island, and Dubai are within easy reach. Residents stay in the heart of the action, with everything from theme parks to cultural landmarks at their fingertips.

For those seeking a residence that embodies waterfront elegance, vibrant lifestyle, and a prime Abu Dhabi address, Yas Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class entertainment, luxurious amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations.
